title: Video, image and chart tiles
blurb: A <video> drawn as a wall of tiles that drift apart, a figure whose image ripples under a caption of plain text, a <picture> whose file is picked by the size the canvas draws it at, an SVG bar chart drawn tilted with its hover styles and links working, and a script-drawn chart saved with its HTML legend as one PNG.
question: Do a video, an image, a picture with srcset, an inline SVG and a nested canvas keep their own behaviour (controls, file choice, :hover, links, checkboxes) when a canvas draws them in pieces, at another size or under a transform?
result: Yes for all five in Chromium 157. A whole draw in an empty clip puts the video's controls back after it is drawn as tiles, sizes alone moves a picture up through its files (and never down), and an affine tilt carries :hover and links with it. A canvas nested in a drawable figure needs contain: paint, or its content is drawn shifted by its offset.
